Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.world

Enum Class Terrain

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Terrain>
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.world.Terrain
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Terrain>, Constable
public enum Terrain extends Enum<Terrain>
The kinds of ground a floor tile can have, and the movement/visibility rules each one implies.

Each terrain has a layout symbol used in hand-written floor layouts and by the ASCII renderer. Secret doors use S in layouts but are displayed as walls until found.
